item.title: Bulletin updated at 09:10 HKT 02/Apr/2026
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An easterly airstream will affect the coast of southern China today. There will be a few showers over the region. Under the persistent influence of troughs of low pressure, the weather will be unsettled over southern China from tomorrow to next Monday. There will be occasional showers and a few squally thunderstorms. With the troughs of low pressure weakening and the anticyclone aloft strengthening, showers will ease off gradually over the coast of southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week. The weather will improve and it will be hot during the day.
